description: The agent MAPS BPL's stroke-program onto its OWN recursive closed-loop cognition — and decides which pieces are ALREADY present vs the residual. Each BplPiece and CognitionElement carries functional ROLES (shared Role nodes); decide_mapping picks, for each BplPiece, the CognitionElement it shares the most roles with (analogical correspondence, an Argmax over the candidate Mappings by role-overlap). flag_residual marks a mapping whose target element is a STUB (a fixed placeholder, not the real capability) — that is the ONE piece of BPL the recursive closed loop does not already subsume. The DECISIONS (the mapping, the residual) are Rules over the agent's own roles; the host stages the pieces and reads the map back. No teacher.

microtheory.name: bpl_cognition_map
microtheory.description: map BPL onto the recursive closed loop; find the residual
